curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: adopt the use of present simple tense to talk about routine activities.

interactions.feedback: Yes! I wash my face every morning.

interactions.prompt: Akinyi does this daily. She ___ breakfast.
interactions.retryHint: With she, the action word often ends in s.

interactions.prompt: We ___ to school from Monday to Friday.
interactions.feedback: Well done! We walk to school.
interactions.retryHint: With we, use walk without s.
Kamau is one person, so add s.

interactions.prompt: Choose the sentence that tells a routine.
choices: I brush my teeth every day.
interactions.answer: I brush my teeth every day.
interactions.feedback: Exactly! That is an everyday routine.
interactions.retryHint: Look for every day and a present action.

interactions.prompt: My sister ___ our plants each Saturday.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! My sister waters the plants.
interactions.retryHint: My sister means she, so add s.
